title: Red's Wither Hoe
description: A simple mod which adds a hoe for aura farmers not for crop farmers.
body:
Hey Everyone, I am back with another mod which has functionality in basically every aspect survival gameplay aspect of the game and the PVP aspect too. and before starting, this mod is made with the inspiration of an already exsisting mod called "**Wither Hoe Mod**" by ibarnstormer_ on CurseForge. I am saying again, INSPIRATION, as the original mod is only up for 1.20.1 and I wanted the mod for the newer versions so that's why I made everything from myself. I didn't took anything from the original mod. Here is the link of the original mod :-                                   
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wither-hoe-mod
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0b2dad92ac585dd313163e731dc961f79387cbb.png)
So this mod is very simple in functionality. I have made a small video about what it does and how to get it. 
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/A6JtyeZTrcc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Uses**                                                                                                         
So, there are some very useful uses for this hoe in survival gameplay.                                 
1. For Ancient Debris mining. as this skull can break through the netherrack very easily due to the netherrack having very low blast resistance.
2. For building, like farms or normal builds, because you can fly like creative with this hoe when held in either main hand or off-hand. and creative flight in survival does gives so much uses too. 
3. and obviously in PVP too. as it has 2 attack damage. and you can shoot the skulls without any cooldown too.

So, Yeah that's it for this mod. Thanks for seeing this and the video too. and also please subscribe to my channel too. Thanks.

-TheRedSmarty
